name: Loycott Loyalty
author: Loycott

sections.description:
In more detailed , Loycott Loyalty Rewards will reward your WooCommerce customers with points , exchangeable to discounts or other gifts based on the Conditions you will create

External services

This plugin connects to an API to obtain loyalty points information.
More specifically connects to domains www.loyapps.com, www.boomsservices.com to obtain loyalty informations.
It sends order customer information (including First Name , Last Name, Address and Phone number) and the total amount of the order every time a new order is made. Service is provided by Booms SMPC .
Privacy Policy at https://www.loycott.com/privacy-policy/
Terms and Conditions at https://www.loycott.com/terms-and-conditions/
sections.installation:
1) Enable plugin from plugins
2) Follow the Wizard to configure your Loyalty and you will be ready to rewards your customers
